title: Unified Memory Substrate (ai-memory), Model Gateway (OmniRoute) & Current/Ideal State Artifacts
acceptance_criteria: current state artifact is produced and validated before the ideal state artifact is updated
the current state artifact records a probe-backed memory substrate node with evidence
ai-memory is the wiki of record and vault/ is a deterministically regenerated mirror
vault-derived tooling fails closed when pointed at the derived mirror
the OpenViking runtime path is retired and replaced by a PROPOSED-only ai-memory adapter
every remote provider available to KAD-PI is reachable through one OmniRoute gateway endpoint
local KAD GGUF endpoints remain KAD-owned and are only proxied, never delegated
the KAD model catalog is refreshed deterministically and degrades without erasing qualification state
no fabricated quota, cost or capability figures enter the CSA or the registry
the memory ISA is a first-class governed domain with deterministic validators
description: Refactor the memory vault, Obsidian vault and knowledge database onto ai-memory as the unified memory substrate (LAN HTTP server with bearer token, zero-LLM consolidation, local embeddings), install OmniRoute as the single OpenAI-compatible gateway that exposes local and remote models to every KAD-PI harness including OMP, replace the OpenViking KnowledgePlane adapter with an ai-memory adapter, and produce the requested Current State Artifact followed by the updated Ideal State Artifact.
